concept.title: Working days
concept.shortdesc: The days of the week a plan works are the workspace's, the same for every project in it: Monday to Friday until a workspace admin changes them, under Workspace settings → Plan calendar. Switch on Saturday there for a six-day week, or switch a day off that your team never works. A plan works at least one day.

conbody.p: Time off, on the same page, lists the days each member is away. A member records their own and an admin anyone's. A task stretches over the days its people are away: it keeps its days of work and ends later, so a five-day task whose only person is away for two of them ends two working days later. With several people on a task it carries on while any of them is there. Adding or removing time off moves the tasks that are not done, and assigning a task to someone else fits it to their time off.

Calendar, above the chart, opens the plan's own calendar. Add each day the plan does not work whatever its weekday, a public holiday or a shutdown, with a name if you like; remove one with its cross. A holiday is skipped exactly as a weekend day is, and shaded on the chart.

Durations and float count working days only. With Monday to Friday, a task that starts on a Thursday and lasts 3 days is due the following Monday, and a task from a Monday to the Friday of the next week has a duration of 10. A start that falls on a day off counts from the next working day. The chart shades the days off at the Days scale. Changing the working days does not move any task's dates: durations and float are counted again.
